sn45.62:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānam mohavinayapariyosānam || pa || sammāsamādhim bhāveti rāgavinaya- dosavinaya- mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || ||
sn45.62:1.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- bahulīkarotī ti || ||
